rationale: A is more operationally sound end to end: it specifies event-driven incremental refresh, explicit stale-chunk exclusion, atomic model-version migrations, strong retrieval-recall evaluation, and concrete production failure mechanisms. B adds a valuable parent-child retrieval design and better refusal calibration, but its refresh sequence risks inconsistent live indexes, its suggestion that tombstoned chunks remain queryable can leak stale content, and its fallback to unverified general knowledge conflicts with the grounding contract. A therefore provides the safer and more internally consistent design.
